plans.text: A locked-room mystery: Edmund Vane is found dead; Detective Mara Voss identifies his nephew Julian as the killer via Julian's knowledge of the hidden vault key.
The sealed letter must be read aloud at the will reading before the book ends.
The rain-on-glass motif repeats deliberately in scenes 1, 3, and 6.
Julian's claim to have been in the city all week is an intentional lie; the contradiction with objective state is deliberate.

Julian's premature knowledge of the floorboard in scene 3 is the central clue; it is explained in scene 5 (he watched Edmund hide the key). A knowledge detector should surface it, and the author marks it intentional.

Only Brandt saw her do it
Mara had told no one about the floorboard
